The opponent's active Pokémon is Hisuian Samurott (Water/Dark), while my active Gholdengo is at 53% HP with a -1 Special Attack stat drop.

<thought

Dragonite naturally outspeeds Kingambit.

1. **Multiscale Advantage**: At 100% HP, Dragonite takes very little damage from any of Kingambit's hits (Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch), even with Supreme Overlord boosts (only 2 allies fainted so far).

Given that Multiscale safely absorbs any incoming hit from Kingambit while `dragondance` punishes Sucker Punch and defensive Terastallization, setting up Dragon Dance is the optimal high-reward, low-risk play.
</thought>
<decision>
ACTION: MOVE: dragondance
</decision>
